about_the_game:
Add hundreds of small dogs to your game with the Puppy Park pack! Yiula is here with a massive pack of character sprites and MV-sized tiles to help you build large dog parks for your heroes to enjoy. With more than 30 dog breeds to choose from (and tons of color variations for each), you can make sure that every dog has their own distinct look! From corgis to mini pinschers and basset hounds to yorkies, if you’ve been looking for small dog breeds this pack likely has what you’re looking for. Need a tan pomeranian? This pack has it! Want to give your hero a gray dachshund and white maltese? Or want to make your shopkeeper a brown pug? You can with this pack!

Want to show off even more of a dog’s personality? Then use the included accessories to turn a boring bulldog into a bow-wearing princess! Collars and bows in different colors can easily help your players recognize certain dogs, and add some silly personality to a pooch with glasses, a frisbee hanging from their mouth, and even their tongue swinging while they walk.

And if all that wasn’t enough, dog sprites aren’t the only thing in this pack! 6 A1, 5 A2, 1 A5, and 14 B sheets are filled with different types of grounds, cliffs, shrubbery, and rails so you can make the perfect dog park for your game. Want the canine fun to continue even in the menus? Then grab one of the 10 windowskins with bone or paw print details and replace human portraits with puppy silhouettes. If you’re making a game with dogs as the main characters, or you just want to include your favorite dog breed in your game, check out the Puppy Park pack!



Contents:

- Over 1000 characters sheets for 33 small dog breeds in various normal and fantasy colours
- Includes Affenpinscher, Basset Hound, Bichon Frise, Brussels Griffon, American Bulldog, Carin Terrier, Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Cesky Terrier, Chihuahua, Chinese Crested, Corgi, Dachshund, Dandie Dinmont Terrier, French Bulldog, Glen of Imaal Terrier, Havanese, Jack Russel Terrier, Japanese Chin, Maltese, Miniature Pinscher, Miniature Schnauzer, Papillon, Pekingese, Pomeranian, Pug, Schipperke, Scottish Terrier, Shih Tzu, Skye Terrier, Tibetan Spaniel, Toy Poodle, Westie, and Yorkshire Terrier dogs
- .Psd files with accessories like shadows, collars, bows, glasses, protruding tongues, and frisbees for extra customization
- Tile A1 of water on various grounds and in basins
- Tile A5 of grass, sand, rocks, snow, checkered tiles, cobblestones, stairs, and alien terrain
- Tile A2 enabling smooth layering of all A5 terrains
- Tile B with thick grass, rocky cliffs, lush trees, and alternate versions with rocks, autumn trees, bare trees, and logs
- Tile C with decorative pillars, benches, statues, fencing, bridges, paving stones, and lush foliage, in several alternate colours
- Various repeatable hedge and flower walls that can be in or out of planters
- 10 dappled light .pngs that can be put over any map to create a forest grove atmosphere
- Themed window skins in paws and bones
- Face sheets of canine silhouettes and accessories
- Character sheets of accessories, flying frisbees, and holes dug in both dirt and rock walls


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
